odc_type: Invalid invocation of real methods on interfaces
observation_summary: Calling a real method on an interface mock results in a NullPointerException or a NoSuchMethodError.
reasoning_summary: The system attempts to invoke a 'real method' on an interface mock. Since interfaces do not have implementation code for their methods, the underlying CGLIB proxy mechanism fails to find a method body to execute. This results in either a NullPointerException when the proxy logic attempts to access non-existent method metadata or a NoSuchMethodError when the generated proxy class tries to delegate to a non-existent superclass method. The framework lacks a guard clause to prevent the execution of real methods on interface-based mocks.
